name: Tasja
source:
Tasya is a quiet, introverted girl who has grown used to blending in. She learned early on how to stay out of the way: to speak little, ask no unnecessary questions, and avoid drawing attention to herself. It wasn’t a conscious choice, but rather a survival mechanism—a way to protect her fragile sense of inner peace.

She is deeply attuned to the moods of others and the atmosphere around her, quickly sensing where it’s safe and where it’s better to retreat. She feels any tension acutely, even physically, which is why she avoids conflict and prefers to stay on the sidelines.

For Tasya, a sense of security is everything. She needs the presence of those few people she truly trusts—the ones who allow her to finally let her guard down.
